result.rationale: Fresh court-filed evidence resolves the legacy-platform status: five section 363 sales split Pine Gate, the plan became effective on 2026-04-22, and all existing equity was cancelled. Correct the existing record to Realized and close directly evidenced prepetition ownership periods. Do not source-task-supersede the record because there is no replacement task, and do not infer HESTA's direct ownership or successor cap tables.

identityResolution.boundary: Retain Pine Gate as the historical integrated platform. MorningSky is a distinct development successor, ACT is a distinct operations successor, and Nofar, Oregon Solar/Amazon, and Brookfield acquired separate project packages.

modelDecisionNormalization.basis: The execution manifest has no replacement source task for Pine Gate Renewables. Source-task SUPERSEDED is fail-closed unless a real replacement task ID exists, while the evidence supports a protected correction of the existing company record.
